Natural Language Query: Identify all public schools within a 2-mile buffer of active industrial chemical facilities, and calculate the total estimated student population inside that zone.
Target GIS Operations: Buffer, Spatial Join, Point-in-Polygon, Attribute Summarization

Natural Language Query: Find every residential parcel that sits within 500 meters of a planned transit stop, excluding any parcels currently classified under commercial zoning.
Target GIS Operations: Buffer, Select by Location, Attribute Query (NOT/Exclude), Spatial Filter

Natural Language Query: Which fire stations are located within a 10-minute drive-time catchment of the downtown commercial district during peak traffic hours?
Target GIS Operations: Network Analysis, Service Area / Isochrone Generation, Spatial Intersect
Typical Data Layers: Fire Stations (Points), Road Network with Live/Historical Speeds (Lines), Downtown Boundary (Polygon)

Natural Language Query: Intersect the current 100-year FEMA flood zones with local county tax parcel data to export a list of parcel IDs and aggregate assessed property value at risk.
Target GIS Operations: Intersect, Spatial Overlay, Sum Aggregation, Tabular Export
Typical Data Layers: FEMA Flood Hazard Areas (Polygons), County Parcels with Tax Assessments (Polygons)

Natural Language Query: Clip the regional agricultural land cover layer to the county boundary and calculate the percentage change in cropland area between 2018 and 2024.
Target GIS Operations: Clip, Area Calculation, Raster Reclassification / Tabulate Area, Percentage Change
Typical Data Layers: NLCD / Cropland Data Layer (Raster), County Boundary (Polygon)

Natural Language Query: Find all road segments in our transportation network that intersect wetlands or critical wildlife corridors.
Target GIS Operations: Select by Location, Intersect, Line Splitting / Spatial Join
Typical Data Layers: Road Centerlines (Lines), National Wetlands Inventory (Polygons), Wildlife Corridors (Polygons)

Natural Language Query: Identify suitable locations for a new community clinic by filtering for census tracts where median household income is below $45,000, distance to the nearest existing hospital exceeds 5 miles, and public transit stops are within a 10-minute walk.
Target GIS Operations: Multi-Criteria Evaluation (MCE), Attribute Query, Euclidean Distance / Buffer, Isochrone / Service Area, Raster/Vector Overlay
Typical Data Layers: Census Tracts with ACS Income (Polygons), Hospitals (Points), Transit Stops (Points)

Natural Language Query: Locate undeveloped parcels larger than 10 acres that are zoned light industrial, have an average terrain slope under 5%, and sit within 1 mile of an interstate freight corridor.
Target GIS Operations: Slope Analysis (DEM), Buffer, Attribute Query, Multi-layer Intersect / Boolean Overlay
Typical Data Layers: Parcels (Polygons), Zoning (Polygons), Elevation DEM (Raster), Interstate Corridors (Lines)

Natural Language Query: Count the number of 311 pothole service requests within each city council district over the last 12 months, and normalize the count by total road centerline mileage in each district.
Target GIS Operations: Temporal Filtering, Point-in-Polygon Count, Length Summarization, Attribute Field Normalization
Typical Data Layers: 311 Service Requests (Points), City Council Districts (Polygons), Road Centerlines (Lines)

Natural Language Query: Aggregate annual solar radiation raster values across commercial building footprints to rank the top 20 rooftops with the highest photovoltaic generation potential.
Target GIS Operations: Zonal Statistics (Mean/Sum), Attribute Filter, Sorting / Top-N Ranking
Typical Data Layers: Solar Radiation Raster (LiDAR/Solar Analysis), Building Footprints with Use Codes (Polygons)

Natural Language Query: Calculate the density of retail food stores per square kilometer across each neighborhood planning unit.
Target GIS Operations: Kernel Density / Spatial Aggregation, Area Calculation, Rate/Density Normalization
Typical Data Layers: Retail Food Businesses (Points), Neighborhood Planning Units (Polygons)

Natural Language Query: Detect areas where NDVI dropped by more than 30% between June 2023 and June 2024 within the state forest boundary to identify potential pest infestation zones.
Target GIS Operations: Spectral Index Math (Raster Calculator), Temporal Difference / Change Detection, Threshold Masking, Mask / Clip

Natural Language Query: Calculate the cut-and-fill volume difference between the pre-construction LiDAR digital elevation model (DEM) and the post-grading surface survey.
Target GIS Operations: Cut/Fill Analysis, Raster Subtraction, Volumetric Calculation

Natural Language Query: Filter satellite imagery footprints over the target county that have less than 15% cloud cover and were captured within 48 hours following the landfall date.
Target GIS Operations: STAC Metadata Filtering, Spatial Intersect, Attribute / Temporal Range Query
Typical Data Layers: Scene Footprints / STAC Catalog (Polygons + Metadata), County Boundary (Polygon)

Natural Language Query: Calculate the shortest emergency response routes from Station 4 to all reported structural fires, accounting for current one-way street directions and active bridge closures.
Target GIS Operations: Network Dataset Routing (Dijkstra / A*), Turn Restriction / Dynamic Barrier Enforcement
Typical Data Layers: Road Network Graph (Lines + Attributes/Barriers), Fire Station (Point), Incident Reports (Points)

Natural Language Query: Group our mobile field inspection locations into five balanced service clusters that minimize total daily vehicle routing distance.
Target GIS Operations: Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) Solver, Spatial Clustering (K-Means / Location-Allocation)
Typical Data Layers: Inspection Target Locations (Points), Depot Location (Point), Road Network Graph (Lines)
